title: Regional capacity askboard - weekly snapshot
content:
Summary: weekly snapshot of open capacity asks across regions. Use this board to track approvals, blockers, and temporary allocations. Allocation SLA: infra triage responds within 3 business days; final approval typically within 10 business days for reserved capacity. Contact: aisha@redwood.ai; triage channel: #infra-capacity.

Columns: RequestID | Team | Requester (owner) | Type | GPUs (model x count) | vCPUs | RAM(GB) | Region | Start | End | Priority | Business impact summary | Dependencies / blockers | Approval status | Approver | Notes | Linked ticket

R-2026-071 | applied-ml | Maya Chen | Dedicated pool (reserved) | A100-80GB x 8 | 256 | 2048 | us-west1 | 2026-08-01 | 2027-02-01 | P0 | Critical training throughput for q3 model retrains (weekly runs). If delayed, training cadence will slip and push back releases. | Data ingress + KMS key pending, docker image >100GB needs staging | awaiting-approval | infra-lead | Need isolated network for dataset compliance; suggest temporary burst capacity in us-central until routing fixed. | MLENG-210

R-2026-072 | serving-runtime | Diego Morales | Ephemeral (spot/burst) | H100-80GB x 4 | 64 | 512 | eu-west2 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-08-10 | P1 | Performance testing for new KV cache logic. Must complete before canary rollout. | Canary ordering, perf bench scripts missing metrics tag | approved-provisionally | sre-oncall | Approved for test window; please use preemptible label and checkpoint state frequently. | INFRA-4237

R-2026-073 | platform-engineering | Harpreet Singh | Dedicated pool (reserved) | A40-48GB x 6 | 192 | 1024 | asia-east1 | 2026-09-01 | 2027-03-01 | P1 | Platform integration testing for private deployments in APAC. Business: unlock early customer pilot. | Network peering tickets open; HSM integration review outstanding | in-review | security-eng | Requesting staggered start (2x GPUs by 9/1 then scale to 6 by 9/15). Consider mixed-instance placement. | ACC-109

R-2026-074 | console-and-tooling | Sara Kim | Ephemeral (dev/test) | T4 x 12 | 48 | 192 | us-east4 | 2026-07-22 | 2026-07-30 | P2 | UX testing for rollout of new cost dashboard. Low risk but rapid turnaround required. | None | approved | product-ops | Use preemptible; coordinate with cost-tracking to label requests for billing. | 

R-2026-075 | private-deployments | Elena Rodriguez | Dedicated pool (reserved) | L40s-32GB x 10 | 320 | 1536 | gov-west1 | 2026-10-01 | 2027-10-01 | P0 | Enterprise pilot requiring air-gapped nodes + strict KMS/HSM controls. Revenue-critical pilot. | Compliance signoff pending (legal + security) | pending-compliance | head-sec | Requires on-prem packaging timeline; estimate procurement of gov-region racks ~8-12 weeks. | LEGAL-78, SEC-215

R-2026-076 | solutions-engineering | Tom Brenner | Short-term (demo) | A100-40GB x 2 | 16 | 128 | us-west2 | 2026-07-26 | 2026-07-28 | P2 | Customer demo for prospective enterprise; non-production. | Demo data sanitized | approved | solutions-lead | Keep demo image <50GB to speed provisioning. | 

R-2026-077 | research-inference | Priya Nair | Dedicated (spot-to-reserve) | H100-80GB x 12 | 384 | 3072 | eu-central1 | 2026-08-15 | 2026-12-15 | P0 | Long-running evals comparing quantized kernels; high GPU-hours. Reqs to support variance experiments. | Need quota increase and storage IOPS review | awaiting-ops | infra-manager | Propose split across two zones to reduce thermal scheduling risk. Consider temporary borrowing from test pool. | RESEARCH-55

Operational notes:
- Prioritization guidance: P0 = business blocking/revenue-impacting or compliance; P1 = important for shipping core features; P2 = non-blocking experiments / demos.
- If 'awaiting-approval' > 7 days, add to weekly SRE sync for escalation.
- Suggested provisional allocations: small burst grants (<=4 GPUs) can be given from 'ephemeral/test' pool; anything >8 GPUs or dedicated pools requires capacity committee approval.
- Capacity committee meets Tue 10:30am PT; add urgent items to agenda via INFRA-4237 comment.

Open questions / to do:
- Confirm APAC region device availability and procurement lead time for L40s; Harpreet to follow up with procurement.
- Define template for staggered ramp requests (requested by platform-engineering).
- Create automated label in provisioning API to mark "capacity-intake" requests so billing shows on preliminary chargeback reports.

History: this sheet pulls recent asks from Linear and manual entries; treat as working tracker (not authoritative ledger). For finalized allocations, see "fleet-allocation-register" (Confluence link above).
